impact: A slight miss eases the fear of a hot print after Tuesday's CPI, but 6.5% annual wholesale inflation keeps the December hike priced in, so yields above 5% remain the main risk for NBIS, BE, PLTR and MU; C benefits from higher short rates.
summary: US producer prices rose 0.3% in October, slightly below the 0.4% forecast, and core PPI (ex food and energy) also rose 0.3%, in line. The annual rate reached 6.5%, the fastest since November 2022. Goods rose 0.5% and services 0.2%; energy eased 0.1% while food jumped 1.3%. September was revised up to +1.4% from +1.3%.
title: October PPI +0.3% vs 0.4% expected; 6.5% y/y, highest since 2022
